categories.main_business_segments: Saimo Technology operates primarily in three business segments: intelligent equipment, automation, and information technology. The intelligent equipment segment includes products such as measurement and detection devices, packaging and palletizing robots, and intelligent logistics and warehousing equipment. The automation segment focuses on automated production lines, logistics systems, and inspection systems for industries like new energy, semiconductors, and engineering machinery. The information technology segment provides industrial internet platforms, industrial software, IoT, AI applications, and SaaS products to support digital transformation in manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including industrial internet, big data, AI, cloud computing, and IoT to develop integrated digital and automation solutions. Key products utilize high-precision measurement technology (e.g., electronic belt scales with 0.2 accuracy level certified internationally), robotics for automated sampling and packaging, and AI-driven diagnostic systems for equipment monitoring. Production methods include order-based manufacturing with processes such as mechanical processing, assembly, software integration, and system testing. The company also emphasizes modular and intelligent storage systems and AI-enabled industrial software development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Saimo serves a broad range of industrial customers including energy and mining, metallurgy and building materials, chemical and pharmaceutical, machinery and electronics, automotive, and food industries. Key customers include large state-owned enterprises, listed companies, and industry leaders such as BYD, Yihua Lithium Energy, and major coal and power plants. The company also targets emerging sectors like new energy (photovoltaic, wind power) and green low-carbon industries, expanding its market reach domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with significant sales in East China, North China, Southwest and Northwest China, Central China, Northeast China, and South China regions. It also has a minor presence in overseas markets, including strategic partnerships for international promotion. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Xuzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, with subsidiaries and offices in Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, Hefei, and Luoyang.
categories.supply_chain_position: Saimo Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial manufacturing supply chain. It provides integrated intelligent equipment, automation systems, and industrial software solutions that enable manufacturing enterprises to digitize and automate their production processes. The company designs, manufactures, and implements equipment and software, positioning itself as a system integrator and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-product manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, emphasizing digitalization, automation, and intelligent manufacturing solutions. R&D priorities include upgrading measurement and sampling equipment with AI and industrial internet technologies, developing intelligent packaging and logistics systems, and advancing industrial software with AI large models and machine vision. It aims to expand in new energy and green low-carbon markets, enhance AI integration across products, and strengthen internal collaboration to optimize resource allocation and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Saimo generates revenue primarily through product sales of intelligent equipment, automation projects, and information technology solutions. It secures contracts mainly via public bidding and direct sales, providing customized system integration services based on client requirements. Revenue streams include sales of hardware products, software licenses, system integration services, and after-sales support. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, though these are not core revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Saimo positions itself as a leading digital and automation solutions provider in China’s instrument manufacturing industry, recognized for its high-precision measurement products and comprehensive intelligent manufacturing ecosystem. It holds national and provincial honors, including ‘China Manufacturing Single Champion Product’ and membership in top industrial internet alliances. While specific competitors are not named, the company competes in sectors such as industrial automation, robotics, and industrial software, maintaining a competitive edge through technological innovation and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Saimo reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 551 million, a 33.99% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to the parent company of about RMB 86.6 million, reflecting a 90.33% decline. The decline was mainly due to reduced revenue in the automation segment, especially in automated warehousing and logistics, and lower investment income. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 1.31 billion, with net assets of RMB 729.6 million. Despite recent losses, the company maintains a substantial scale with ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and expand in new markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Saimo emphasizes its unique value proposition in delivering integrated digital and automation solutions that combine intelligent equipment, industrial internet platforms, and AI-driven software. Its products, such as the world-leading 0.2 accuracy electronic belt scale and advanced robotic sampling systems, offer superior precision and reliability. The company’s ability to provide end-to-end solutions from design to implementation, coupled with strong R&D capabilities and strategic industry partnerships, differentiates it as a trusted partner for manufacturing enterprises undergoing digital transformation and green upgrading.
